name: Volcano Domain
body:
Deities: Deities of earth, stone, fire, or the jungle can offer this domain to their clerics.

Granted Powers: Your fiery devotion to your deity manifests through your magic as burning flames and crushing stones.

Toxic Gas (Sp)

As a standard action, you unleash a ball of toxic gas from your outstretched hand. You can target any single foe within 30 feet as a ranged touch attack with this ball of toxic gas. If you hit the foe, the gas deals 1d6 points of acid damage + 1 point for every two cleric levels you possess. You can use this ability a number of times per day equal to 3 + your Wisdom modifier.

Flames Of Passion (Su)

At 8th level, your passion for your faith manifests in two ways. First, in addition to dealing normal damage, any melee weapon you wield in battle deals an amount of fire damage equal to 1/2 your Wisdom modifier (minimum 1). (This damage stacks with a weapon’s special qualities such as a flaming weapon.) Second, you add your Charisma modifier (minimum 1) as a circumstance bonus to all Will saving throws.

Domain: 1st–touch of combustion, 2nd–tar ball, 3rd–raging rubble, 4th–volcanic storm, 5th–pyrotechnic eruption, 6th–tar pool, 7th–caustic eruption, 8th–wall of lava, 9th–fiery body.

Special: This domain is available to druids through their Nature Bond class feature.

Into the Wilds: Mountains and Volcanoes, Copyright 2024, Bloodstone Press; author Beth Jones
